counter: # Maps the suite's counter columns to events in AMD uProf CPU-profile reports.
# Pattern forms (tried in priority order per counter):

priority: summed. Keys are "PMCx<code>:<unit mask>" (from the report's
e.g. PMCx043:0x08) or exact event names.

counter: #   anything else: a case-insensitive Python regex over event names (first match wins);
#                names that look like derived metrics (rate/ratio/%/PTI/...) are skipped.
# Codes/masks below are the ones uProf itself uses on Zen 2 (family 17h); event sets A/B

meaning_on_amd_zen: L2 accesses caused by L1D misses (uProf's own L1D-miss definition; includes prefetches)
demand L1D fills from L3/other cache + from DRAM = demand requests that missed L2 and reached the L3 (AMD's LLC)
demand L1D fills from DRAM = L3 misses
